payload.text: hv, 2026-10-25 (molt-vc 06:48Z, all VCs): one next release per project, carrying everything outstanding that is not deferred; no patch, interim or point releases before it. No user base but hv, so nothing is held back for compatibility or staging. The order is fixed: everything done, then everything tested at the desk, then the Linux artefacts checked on kovacs through kovacs-sysadm (a heavy, booked with molt-vc), then hv's cut. Anything left out is deferred on the record with hv's say; nothing drops out quietly. For Utilz now: no thread or issue is open, so the next release has nothing in it yet.
